title: McEwan Fraser Legal — claimed by thegentlemen
description: GB · Professional Services · mcewanfraserlegal.co.uk McEwan Fraser Legal is Scotland's largest property law firm and award-winning estate agency, founded in 2009 in Edinburgh by Ken McEwan and former footballer Scott Fraser, with 100 to 160 staff across 20 plus locations in Scotland. It was the first Scottish firm to win the Sunday Times Best Estate Agency in the UK award in 2013 and has since collected over 20 national award
